name: 2V-R8 (Darth Nox)
description: 2V-R8, also known as Twovee Areight, was a Seneschal-series factotum droid owned by Darth Nox. Assigned to Darth Nox's Fury-class Imperial interceptor in 3643 BBY, 2V-R8 was responsible for maintaining the starship and ensuring that its crew remained comfortable.
